skill.name: validate-requirements
skill.description: Validate user requirements against saved project standards before work begins. Use it to catch missing context, unclear goals, and incomplete briefs.
skill.summary: Checks requirements against project standards before downstream work begins.
skill.author: AbeJitsu

content.value_statement: Incomplete requirements cause wasted work and inconsistent outputs. This skill checks project input against saved standards before generation begins.
actual_capabilities: Checks requirements for completeness, clarity, format, sufficiency, and standards alignment.
Uses saved project validation rules when standards are available.
Falls back to general validation when custom standards do not exist.
Identifies missing context, conflicting requirements, and vague descriptions.
Returns specific issues and recommended clarification questions.
limitations: It does not generate the final implementation or draft.
It depends on accurate saved standards when custom rules are used.
It cannot infer hidden requirements that the user did not provide.
It may need user clarification before the next pipeline step can proceed.

use_cases.title: Preflight Component Requests
use_cases.description: Validate component requests for purpose, props, behavior, and interaction details before generation.

use_cases.title: Check Content Briefs
use_cases.description: Confirm topic, audience, source material, and success criteria are complete before drafting.

use_cases.title: Enforce Shared Standards
use_cases.description: Apply saved project validation rules before work enters a quality pipeline.

prompt_templates.title: Check Basic Requirements
prompt_templates.prompt: Use validate-requirements on this request: [paste request]. Tell me what is missing and ask up to two questions.

prompt_templates.title: Validate Against Standards
prompt_templates.prompt: Use my saved standards for [project type] to validate these requirements: [paste requirements]. Return pass or needs clarification with specific issues.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Pipeline Gate
prompt_templates.prompt: Before generation, validate this source material for [project type]. Check completeness, clarity, format, sufficiency, and standards alignment.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Multi-Input Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Validate these requirements, constraints, examples, and acceptance criteria for [project type]. Compare them to saved validation rules and identify blocking gaps.

output: Missing purpose, required props, and interaction behavior.
Ask where the dropdown is used and which options it should support.

output_examples.input: Refactor this authentication module to improve readability. Keep behavior unchanged and include tests.
output: The goal, constraint, and testing expectation are clear.
Proceed to the next pipeline step.

output_examples.input: Write a blog post about AI.
output: Missing audience, angle, length, source material, and desired outcome.
Ask for the target reader and key points before drafting.

best_practices: Provide project type, goal, constraints, and expected output before validation.
Keep saved standards current so validation rules match team requirements.
Ask the smallest set of clarification questions needed to unblock work.
anti_patterns: Treating vague requests as valid because they mention a general topic.
Skipping saved standards when a project type has custom validation rules.
Returning generic failure messages without naming the missing requirement.

faq.question: What does this skill validate?
faq.answer: It checks user input for completeness, clarity, format, sufficiency, and alignment with saved standards.

faq.question: Does it generate code or content?
faq.answer: No. It validates prerequisites before downstream generation or editing begins.

faq.question: What happens if no saved standards exist?
faq.answer: It uses general validation checks and reports missing context.

faq.question: Can it work with Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. It is marked compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What kind of output should I expect?
faq.answer: A concise validation result with issues, details, recommendation, and summary.

faq.question: When should I run it?
faq.answer: Run it at the start of a quality pipeline before implementation, drafting, or refactoring.
